text: {"assertions":["On 2026-03-18, a broken layout issue in notifications/email/render.py was fixed.","The layout bug only appeared when the input list was empty.","The symptom was a table overflowing in the plain text part of the email renderer.","The root cause was an N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation.","The fix prefetched the relation in a single query instead of multiple queries.","The fix was submitted as PR #4917 on branch fix/broken-layout-1.","The bug could be reproduced by rendering the digest template with a long subject line.","The backlog was cleared five minutes after the fix was deployed."]}
